source.surface: document editor with Review-suggestions side panel, one suggestion expanded and undecided
source.attribution: Screens curated by Mobbin (https://mobbin.com). Inspected remotely through the Mobbin MCP under accessMode 'remote-mcp'. No image was downloaded, cached, embedded, or stored anywhere in this repository; every value below is our own reading of the rendered screen.

evidenceTier.rationale: Mobbin is a curated gallery of captured screens. It is not a live observation we made of a running product, and no audience outcome is attached, so it cannot be silver/M2 or gold/M3. Treat these facts as evidence that a shipped product once looked this way, not as evidence that it worked.

decisionColour.acceptControlTreatment: solid filled green rectangle, white label
decisionColour.rejectControlTreatment: unfilled label text on the panel background, no border, no fill
decisionColour.undecidedContainerTreatment: same white as the surrounding panel, no tint, no border emphasis
decisionColour.documentTreatment: the proposed wording is not written into the document while pending; the original wording stays and is marked with an underline
decisionColour.verdict: The accept colour is confined to the Accept control. The undecided suggestion card carries none of it.
